preconditions.description: The number of nodes in the binary tree must be between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= node.data <= 10**6 for node in nodes)
preconditions.description: The data of each node in the binary tree must be between 0 and 10^6.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'Complete Binary Tree' if is_complete else stdout == 'Not Complete Binary Tree'
postconditions.description: The output must indicate whether the binary tree is complete or not based on the structure of the tree.
